summary: DBS: Singapore's largest bank, high ROE, generous dividends; earnings ease as interest rates fall.

rationale.roeCurrent: ROE ~17% recently; falling rates trim it to ~16%.
rationale.roeStable: Long-run ROE for a top Asian bank.
rationale.payoutRatio: Ordinary plus capital-return dividends ~60% of earnings.

thesis.text: DBS is Singapore's largest bank with industry-leading ROE and a high, growing dividend; falling interest rates will trim net interest margin.

changes.text: First Claude base case and thesis.
